verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party MCP server. The only MCP server mentioned is an explicitly unofficial, community-built Rust CLI/MCP tool, which is a third-party workaround and earns no credit. The REST Cloud API is a developer building block, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
